stories.title: Bastrop launches pilot program to help downtown businesses pay for live music
stories.summary: The city will cover 30% of eligible musician fees, reimbursing businesses up to $400 per performance, with a monthly cap of $1,200 per business.

stories.title: Inmate's escape attempt at Beaumont prison foiled by vigilant TDCJ staff
stories.summary: An inmate at the Larry Gist Unit attempted an escape early Friday but was swiftly recaptured by correctional officers, says the Texas Department of Criminal Justice.

stories.title: Texas AG drops lawsuit against Muslim civil rights group
stories.summary: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton first filed a lawsuit in February 2025 seeking to ban CAIR and its chapters from operating in the state.

stories.title: Austin Mayor Pro Tem Chito Veta announces campaign for Texas Senate District 14
stories.summary: Vela is looking to fill the seat currently held by Texas Comptroller-elect Sarah Eckhardt, who unseated Republican Don Huffines in the November midterm.

stories.title: ERCOT CEO's incentive compensation will now be tied to how the Texas power grid performs
stories.summary: Under the agreement, incentive compensation for ERCOT CEO Pablo Vegas will be earned each year by meeting key grid reliability and performance targets.

stories.title: Political advocate files election contest over Austin's Prop J
stories.summary: Proposition J, which passed in the midterm election, would – in part – allow for the removal of moot or unenforceable language from the city charter.

stories.title: Federal grand jury indicts 21 with alleged connections to prominent Mexican cartel
stories.summary: Among those indicted include a 29-year-old man from Kyle, and two men who stored firearms and accessories in Buda and Bastrop.

stories.title: Forecast:
stories.summary: Here are the latest updates from the KVUE Weather Impact Team.

stories.title: Hutto's Howdy the Hippo 'pens' tribute to Fiona
stories.summary: Fiona, a beloved hippo who lived at the Cincinnati Zoo, died this week after swallowing a knit hat.

stories.title: Teen in Texas foster care wants a family to play board games with
stories.summary: Michael loves board games, Pokemon cards and learning geometry. Christmas is his favorite holiday, and he dreams of riding in sports car.

stories.title: East State Highway 71 in Travis County reopens early Friday after 'serious collision' prompted backup
stories.summary: Drivers were temporarily rerouted after the crash, which was reported shortly before 12:40 a.m. Friday.

stories.title: 'Give him the honor that he's due': Navy sailor Kenneth Lynch finally to be buried in Texas, 85 years after Pearl Harbor attack
stories.summary: The sailor, who left Denton in 1940, will be buried with full military honors next month in his hometown.
